target_area.name: Belfast, Northern Ireland
target_area.notes: Approximate validation envelope only; not a legal or analytical boundary.

sources.name: Current repository 2016 raster baselines
sources.coverage_note: Local GeoTIFFs currently include RGB, NDBI, and NDVI-style layers; the NDVI filename indicates 2018 even though it sits under data/2016.

license.name: Needs upstream confirmation
license.attribution: Record original provider, processing author, processing date, and source scene IDs before publication.

provenance.refresh_method: Do not overwrite. Add corrected rasters as new versioned files and refresh manifest.
provenance.notes: Treat as derived products until original satellite/aerial scene metadata is supplied.

sources.name: Current repository 2026 GeoJSON and JSON layers
sources.coverage_note: Local 2026 files appear to be OpenStreetMap/OpenData-style exports. The indexer records embedded generator/copyright metadata and bbox validation flags.

license.name: Read per-file metadata
license.attribution: Preserve embedded copyright and generator fields in manifests.

provenance.refresh_method: Refresh from the original source query/export and keep the raw export immutable.
provenance.notes: Some files contain Overpass/OpenStreetMap metadata; classify at file level during indexing.

sources.name: Google Earth and manual source drops
sources.coverage_note: Manual imagery interpretation, placemarks, KML/KMZ exports, screenshots, notes, and derived annotations for change events not available through open feeds.

license.name: Provider terms and manual note required
license.attribution: Record provider, capture date, interpreter, and whether geometry is hand-digitized or directly exported.

provenance.refresh_method: Add new dated files under data/manual_drops/<source>/<YYYY>/ and refresh the manifest.
provenance.notes: Do not assume Google imagery or screenshots are redistributable. Keep raw drops separate from open-data derivatives.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API or Overpass Turbo
sources.coverage_note: Current-state extracts are available through Overpass. Historical replay requires saved snapshots, ohsome, or dated replication history rather than live queries alone.

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
license.attribution: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors; keep ODbL attribution with derived databases.

provenance.refresh_method: Store the Overpass QL query, bbox, timestamp, endpoint URL, and response file alongside each export.
provenance.notes: Use small targeted layer queries for roads, buildings, water, green space, transit stops, amenities, and land use.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap regional extracts via Geofabrik
sources.coverage_note: Useful for reproducible regional baseline extracts; historical coverage depends on dated extracts retained by the project or external archives.

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
license.attribution: Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors and Geofabrik extract metadata.

provenance.refresh_method: Record extract date, region, checksum, and clipping steps. Do not commit large PBF downloads unless explicitly approved.
provenance.notes: Best used as an offline source for reproducible clipping and layer derivation.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap history analytics via ohsome API
sources.coverage_note: Supports historical snapshots and time series from OSM full-history data for replay change metrics.

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
license.attribution: Attribute OpenStreetMap contributors and retain ohsome query metadata.

provenance.refresh_method: Store endpoint, request body, temporal filter, keys, values, bbox/polygon, and response checksum.
provenance.notes: Prefer for 2016-2026 historical OSM layer counts and dated geometries.

sources.name: Belfast City Council open data
sources.coverage_note: Potential layers include assets, parks, public services, planning-related lists, neighbourhood services, and civic infrastructure where published.

license.name: Usually UK Open Government Licence where published through official open data channels
license.attribution: Attribute Belfast City Council and retain dataset page URL/license text.

provenance.refresh_method: Record dataset landing page, modified date, download URL, and licence for each file.
provenance.notes: Do not merge with OSM-derived layers until source licence compatibility is checked.

sources.name: OpenDataNI and Spatial NI open data
sources.coverage_note: Candidate source for administrative boundaries, public assets, environmental layers, roads/open mapping, and official Northern Ireland datasets.

license.name: Open Government Licence v3.0 for many public-sector datasets
license.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0, plus dataset-specific copyright.

provenance.refresh_method: Use CKAN/package metadata where available; save package ID, resource ID, modified date, licence, URL, and checksum.
provenance.notes: Some Spatial NI/LPS layers carry extra attribution or commercial restrictions; keep licence text per resource.

sources.name: Belfast Bikes / GBFS-style bike share data
sources.coverage_note: Station locations and availability are useful for mobility replay. Historical availability requires archived polling; station metadata can be refreshed periodically.

license.name: GBFS feed licence should be read from system_information.json when available
license.attribution: Attribute Belfast Bikes/operator and preserve feed licence_id or licence_url.

provenance.refresh_method: Poll only lightweight metadata feeds by default; record feed URL, ttl, last_updated, licence fields, and retrieval timestamp.
provenance.notes: Do not store personal trip data. Keep availability snapshots aggregated unless explicitly approved.

sources.name: Northern Ireland Planning Portal
sources.coverage_note: Planning applications, statuses, decision dates, proposal descriptions, and locations can support development timeline reconstruction.

license.name: Planning Portal terms and public register rights require review before redistribution
license.attribution: Record portal URL, query parameters, application reference, council, and retrieval date.

provenance.refresh_method: Prefer official export endpoints if available; otherwise use rate-limited collection of metadata only and retain source URLs.
provenance.notes: Documents may contain third-party copyright or personal data; keep raw documents out of automated public outputs unless cleared.

sources.name: Translink Northern Ireland public transport data
sources.coverage_note: Routes, stops, timetables, service patterns, and live feeds can support transport replay if archived by year.

license.name: Open Government Licence or Translink Access to Information Licence depending on release
license.attribution: Attribute Translink/NITHC and preserve feed licence or access terms.

provenance.refresh_method: Record feed URL, version/date, route area filter, licence, and checksum; avoid committing large schedules by default.
provenance.notes: Historical service replay requires dated GTFS/TransXChange snapshots or archival sources.

sources.name: Northern Ireland Air quality data
sources.coverage_note: Monitoring station observations for pollutants such as NO2, PM10, PM2.5, ozone, sulphur dioxide, and carbon monoxide.

license.name: Northern Ireland Air / DAERA terms; UK-AIR mapping products may have separate restrictions
license.attribution: Attribute Northern Ireland Air, DAERA/local council monitoring network, station, pollutant, and retrieval date.

provenance.refresh_method: Store station list, pollutant, interval, start/end dates, endpoint, and checksum.
provenance.notes: Use observations for time-series context; do not conflate measured station data with modelled maps without source labels.

sources.name: NISRA population and census statistics
sources.coverage_note: Census 2021, mid-year population estimates, and small-area statistics can contextualize replay demand and neighbourhood change.

license.name: Open Government Licence for many official statistics releases
license.attribution: Attribute Northern Ireland Statistics and Research Agency and dataset/table title.

provenance.refresh_method: Record publication, table ID, geography, release date, and checksum.
provenance.notes: Keep original statistical geography identifiers to avoid ambiguous joins.

sources.name: NISRA deprivation measures
sources.coverage_note: Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017 is the main deprivation baseline in the replay period unless newer releases are added.

license.name: Open Government Licence for many official statistics releases
license.attribution: Attribute NISRA and the deprivation measure release.

provenance.refresh_method: Record release name, indicator/domain, geography, publication date, and checksum.
provenance.notes: Join by official SOA/DZ codes, not display names.

sources.name: NISRA SOA and Data Zone boundaries
sources.coverage_note: SOA boundaries support older small-area statistics. Census 2021 Data Zones and Super Data Zones support newer statistics.

license.name: Open Government Licence for many NISRA/OpenDataNI boundary products
license.attribution: Attribute NISRA, OpenDataNI/Spatial NI, and boundary product version.

provenance.refresh_method: Record geography version, boundary generalisation level, coordinate reference system, publication date, and checksum.
provenance.notes: Use these as official join geographies for population and deprivation layers.

sources.name: Sentinel, Landsat, and Copernicus Earth observation products
sources.coverage_note: Supports yearly imagery, NDVI, NDBI, impervious surface, land cover, and change detection products.

license.name: Copernicus free, full and open data policy; Landsat data generally public domain/open
license.attribution: Record mission, product, processing level, scene ID, acquisition date, cloud cover, provider, and derived processing steps.

provenance.refresh_method: Store STAC/catalog metadata first; download scenes only when explicitly needed and keep checksums outside git if large.
provenance.notes: Prefer cloud-optimized metadata workflows and derived small rasters for committed fixtures.

status_values.available_local: Source files already exist in this repository.
status_values.partially_available_local: Some local files exist but source queries or historical coverage need expansion.
status_values.drop_zone_ready: Directory and manifest workflow exist, but source files arrive manually.
status_values.planned: Inventory entry exists; acquisition not yet implemented in this branch.
